title: Blood sugar health showed the same pattern.

statement.detail: Heart, kidney and blood-sugar disease combined — enough movement in fewer days was linked to the same lower risk.

_provenance.finding: mvpa · weekend warrior equivalence · confidence 0.65 · 22 studies

claims.paper: doi:10.1186_s12889-026-27719-0 · Sun et al. 2026, BMC Public Health, n=76,875, 8.1y median
claims.quote: Compared with inactive participants, regularly active (HR = 0.82, 95% CI: 0.77-0.87) and WW (HR = 0.83, 95% CI: 0.79-0.87) had lower risks of transitioning from healthy to FCRMD
